::: {#cor-bayes-proportional}
#### The posterior is proportional to likelihood times prior

As a function of $\theta$, with the data $\vy$ held fixed,

$$
\underbrace{\p(\theta \mid \vy)}_{\text{posterior}}
\;\propto\;
\underbrace{\p(\vy \mid \theta)}_{\text{likelihood}}
\cdot
\underbrace{\p(\theta)}_{\text{prior}}.
$$ {#eq-bayes-proportional}
:::

::: proof
In @eq-bayes-posterior,
the denominator $\p(\vy)$ does not depend on $\theta$.
:::
